items.source: Build a ContentNegotiationManager based on this configurer's settings.
items.translation: 构建一个基于此配置器设置的ContentNegotiationManager。

items.source: An alternative to mediaType(String, MediaType).
items.translation: mediaType(String, MediaType) 的替代方案。

items.source: Similar to mediaType(String, MediaType) but for replacing existing mappings.
items.translation: 类似于mediaType(String, MediaType)，但用于替换现有映射。

items.source: The path extension strategy will also try to use ServletContext.getMimeType(String) and MediaTypeFactory to resolve path extensions. To change this behavior see the useRegisteredExtensionsOnly(boolean) property.
items.translation: 路径扩展策略还将尝试使用ServletContext.getMimeType(String)和MediaTypeFactory来解析路径扩展。要更改此行为，请查看useRegisteredExtensionsOnly(boolean)属性。

items.source: As of 5.0 you can set the exact strategies to use via strategies(List).
items.translation: 从 5.0 版本开始，您可以通过 strategies(List) 设置要使用的确切策略。

items.source: If destinations are present that do not support any of the given media types, consider appending MediaType.ALL at the end.
items.translation: 如果存在不支持任何给定媒体类型的目标，请考虑在末尾追加MediaType.ALL。

items.source: By default, this is not set in which case ParameterContentNegotiationStrategy will use defaults if available.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值未设置，在这种情况下，ParameterContentNegotiationStrategy 将使用可用的默认值。

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: When favorParameter(boolean) is set, this property determines whether to use only registered MediaType mappings to resolve a path extension to a specific MediaType.
items.translation: 当设置favorParameter(boolean)时，此属性确定是否仅使用已注册的MediaType映射来将路径扩展解析为特定的 MediaType。

items.source: Set a custom ContentNegotiationStrategy to use to determine the content type to use when no content type is requested.
items.translation: 设置自定义的ContentNegotiationStrategy，用于在请求中未指定内容类型时确定要使用的内容类型。

items.source: Set the query parameter name to use when favorParameter(boolean) is on.
items.translation: 设置当启用favorParameter(boolean)时使用的查询参数名称。

items.source: extension - the key to look up
items.translation: extension - 要查找的键

items.source: mediaType - the media type
items.translation: mediaType - 媒体类型

items.source: Note: use of this method is mutually exclusive with use of all other setters in this class which customize a default, fixed set of strategies. See class level doc for more details.
items.translation: 注意： 使用此方法与其他自定义默认固定策略集的所有其他 setter 方法是互斥的。有关更多详细信息，请参阅类级别文档。

items.source: By default this is set to false.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为false。

items.source: The default parameter name is "format".
items.translation: 默认参数名为"format"。

items.source: By default this value is set to false.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为false。

items.source:
This factory offers properties that in turn result in configuring the
underlying strategies. The table below shows the property names, their
default settings, as well as the strategies that they help to configure:
items.translation: 该工厂提供属性，进而配置底层策略。下表显示了属性名称、默认设置以及它们用于配置的策略：

items.source:
Set the default content type(s) to use when no content type is requested
in order of priority.
items.translation: 设置默认内容类型，当未请求内容类型时按优先级使用。

items.source:
Whether a request parameter ("format" by default) should be used to
determine the requested media type.
items.translation: 是否应使用请求参数（默认为 "format"）来确定请求的媒体类型。

items.source: Whether to disable checking the 'Accept' request header.
items.translation: 是否禁用对“Accept"请求头的检查。

items.source:
Add a mapping from a key, extracted from a path extension or a query
parameter, to a MediaType.
items.translation: 添加一个映射，将提取自路径扩展名或查询参数的键映射到 `MediaType`。

items.source: Set the exact list of strategies to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的确切策略列表。

items.source: strategies - the strategies to use
items.translation: strategies - 要使用的策略

items.source: Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Rossen Stoyanchev
